coverage.evidence: HypeTrainStateHelpers.cs:18-55 and HypeTrainWhoHelpers.cs:18-30 register the 13 live keys (isActive, level, progress, goal, percent, bar, remaining, timeLeft, total, topContributor, record.level, isGolden, isShared), and TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:357-377 registers hype_train.id/level/total/goal, 17 in all. None takes an argument: LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:180, 195 and 207 return null (shown as written) when call.Args.Count != 0.

HypeTrainStateHelpers.cs:19-55: level uses LiveText.Plain; progress, goal, remaining and total use LiveText.Count with call.Culture (StreamText.cs:30 N0). Remaining is Math.Max(0, goal-progress) (LiveText.cs:33). Percent rounds away from zero (MusicText.cs:47-49). The bar is 10 marks (MeterBars.cs:17) plus a space and the percent (LiveText.cs:40-50). TimeLeft follows StreamText.cs:68-75 (h m / m s / s). NumberCulture.cs:22-34 falls back to English, and the culture comes from the channel Language set from Locale (TemplateRenderScope.cs:37, ChannelService.cs:593, settings en.json title Language). The examples match the samples (1,800/3,000 gives 60%, 6 marks, 1,200).

LiveEventRow.cs:34 gives every hypetrain row TemplateHelperContexts.Standard, which is every context except Viewer (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22; TemplateHelperContext.cs: Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord, Webhook). TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-106 EventSourceOnlyContexts = EventResponse and Pipeline for hype_train.*.

HypeTrainEventHandler.cs:28-35: the begin event seeds hype_train.id, level, total and goal; HypeTrainEventHandler.cs:75-81: the end event seeds id, level and total, with no goal. The values use int ToString with no separator. TemplateHelperSamples.cs:59-62 holds the samples 1b0AsbInCHZW2SQFQkCzqN07Ib2/3/6400/8000. The event labels Hype train starts and Hype train ends are in event-responses i18n en.json:25-26.

LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:202-209: a Flag prints LiveText.Flag(false) when there is no current train. LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:171-182: a Train row prints null (as written) when Current is null. LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:186-198: a Record row reads AllTimeHigh and prints null only when no record exists (TwitchHypeTrainDtos.cs:21-28). On a failed Twitch read, LiveHypeTrainData.cs:147 returns a null status, so the flags give false and record.level and the others show as written. One read per render: LiveHypeTrainData.cs:123-134 memoizes it in scope.Items.

HypeTrainWhoHelpers.cs:18-23: topContributor is TopContributions.MaxBy(Total).UserName, built through LiveHypeTrainRows.Train, so it is available only while Current is non-null (LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:180). UserName is the display name field (TwitchHypeTrainDtos.cs:50-56).

reader_answers.evidence: There are no arguments (LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:180, 195, 207). The live keys are listed in HypeTrainStateHelpers.cs and HypeTrainWhoHelpers.cs. hype_train level, total, goal and id are seeded by HypeTrainEventHandler.cs:28-35, and the end handler seeds no live train data (HypeTrainEventHandler.cs:75-81).

LiveHypeTrainData.cs:145-146 reads the Twitch Helix hype train status for the broadcaster. Live rows print only while Current is set (LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:180). EventSourceOnlyContexts is EventResponse and Pipeline (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-106).

Two namespaces: the provider namespace hypetrain (LiveEventHelperProvider.cs:85-86) and the seeded hype_train keys (HypeTrainEventHandler.cs:31-34). A null render leaves the token as written (LiveEventRow.cs:22-24). The !train example output matches the samples in HypeTrainStateHelpers.cs:19-50.

topContributor reads the current train (HypeTrainWhoHelpers.cs:18-23, LiveHypeTrainRows.cs:180) and is allowed in EventResponse (TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22). The if path form {if.<path>:then|else} tests truth with IsTrue, so false is false (IfTemplateHelpers.cs:142-157, LogicArguments.cs:31-35). isActive is not an operator name, so the path form applies.
